job.title: [Post] Mahidhar A - Ranosys Is Hiring
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

You are hiring professionals who deliver enterprise customer platforms – I have built and integrated enterprise commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell for 5+ years.

– Developed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers
– Resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international teams
– Analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications, supported UAT
– Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively across analysis, development, testing and documentation

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Would you have 15 minutes for a short call in the coming days? My CV and cover letter are attached.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Commerce Developer & Techno-Functional Consultant | Java, APIs & Integrations
tailoring.summary: Commerce developer and techno-functional consultant with 5+ years on enterprise B2B and B2C platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful and OCC APIs and integrations with ERP, MDM and PIM systems. Works directly with business stakeholders on requirements, user stories and solution design, executed CI/CD deployment cycles and supports production. Uses generative AI tools daily. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer, agile and experienced in international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Ranosys delivers enterprise commerce and CRM solutions for clients worldwide, and its growing team offers variety across platforms and industries. My five years building and integrating enterprise commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell – Java, APIs, ERP/PIM integration and requirements work with business teams – translate directly to client delivery.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello Mahidhar, I saw your post that Ranosys is hiring. I bring 5+ years building and integrating enterprise commerce platforms (SAP Commerce) for Rockwell Automation and Shell – Java, APIs, requirements. Based in Karlsruhe, Germany. Could we have a short chat?

en.subject: Application: Commerce / CRM Professional – Ranosys
en.hook: Your post says Ranosys is hiring professionals who deliver enterprise customer and commerce platforms for clients. That is what I have done for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I build and integrate enterprise commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud, working between business stakeholders and IT.

bullets.label: Enterprise platform delivery
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) with Java and Spring; developed and maintained the Promotions Engine, OMS, Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: APIs & integrations
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international teams.

bullets.label: Client requirements
bullets.text: In a techno-functional role, analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications and translated them into SAP Commerce solutions; at Shell, mapped processes and supported UAT.

bullets.label: AI-assisted delivery
bullets.text: Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively to accelerate analysis, development, testing and documentation – with prompt engineering and critical review of the output through code reviews.

en.logistics: I adapt quickly to new platforms thanks to a strong Java and API foundation. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a short conversation about your open roles.
